title: Which YouTube niche to commit to
decision: Start an AI-narrated YouTube channel, and if so, which niche to commit to.

options.label: Hybrid: science and history as stories, what-if lead
Untold history of science and space
Keep doing Odoo work, no channel
90-day pilot of one format, then decide

garyvee.reason: Channel growth is an attention and distribution problem

martell.reason: Six to ten hours a week and product work are the binding limit

brief: A solo founder in Lusaka builds Odoo SaaS. He wants a 30 to 40 minute AI-narrated YouTube channel to grow fast and earn revenue, with about 6 to 10 hours a week and under $500 cash. Choose a niche and format, and test his worries about crowding, factual trust, and algorithm confusion.
assumptions: Cash under $500 total, tools under $50 a month (founder's answer)
6 to 10 hours a week, first video in 4 weeks (founder's answer)
Success targets from founder's example: monetized in 6 months, 1,000 subs and 4,000 watch hours in 12 months (assumed)
Vendor RPM and retention figures are directional only
